item.title: Alternate Digital Realities at the Dawn of Omni-Universe: Social, Cultural, Behavioural and Business Evolutions
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how emerging digital realities are reshaping social, cultural, behavioral, and business landscapes as we enter an omni-universe era. The collection seeks research addressing the transformations and evolutions occurring across these dimensions in response to technological advancement and increasingly interconnected digital environments.
